efficiency.interleaved: V1,V2,V3,V4 x repetitions, fresh child process each
efficiency.memory_metric: peak_rss_bytes = Linux VmHWM of a fresh child process after the timed runs; peak_rss_delta_bytes = VmHWM minus RSS right after model load (the baseline includes the loaded weights and the torch footprint, so the delta is inference-time working memory); peak_rss_sampled_delta_bytes = 10 ms sampler cross-check; weight memory = state_dict_bytes

frozen_before: training start and any test-set model inference

full_test.batch_size_reason: equal to the attack batch size so eps-0 subset predictions are exactly comparable
full_test.macro_f1_labels: labels=range(27), zero_division=0 (same for full test and subset)

fp32.description: white-box gradient of the FP32 model, scored on the same model

int8.description: forward pass is the real INT8 model (asserted bit-equal logits); backward pass goes through each of the 23 INT8 Linear layers using their dequantized weights and ignores activation quantization; softmax, LayerNorm and residuals differentiate normally; candidates are scored by the real INT8 model. Not a straight-through estimator on fake-quant and not an FP32 shadow. Robustness of INT8 models may be over-estimated if this gradient is weak.
int8.label: APPROXIMATE INT8 GRADIENT (BPDA)

robustness.subset_rule: sampling.stratified_subset v1: sorted IDs per class, seed=sha256(name|split_seed|class)[:8], min(k,available)
